themes.headline: 10Y Treasury yield rises 8bp on hotter-than-expected core CPI
themes.summary: Core CPI printed above consensus, reviving concerns the Fed's cutting path slows in H2. Front-end sold off in sympathy but curve bull-flattened intraday as growth-scare bids faded. For portfolios, this argues against adding duration into the print risk this week.

watch_today: Fed speaker slate: two regional presidents

themes.headline: S&P 500 slips 0.6% as rate-sensitive sectors lag
themes.summary: Utilities and real estate led losses on the higher-yield backdrop; mega-cap tech outperformed on resilient earnings guidance. Breadth was weak — decliners outpaced advancers roughly 2:1.

watch_today: Pre-market earnings from two S&P 500 names

themes.headline: IG spreads widen 2bp, first move wider in three weeks
themes.summary: Modest widening tracked the rates move rather than any credit-specific catalyst; new issuance was well absorbed. HY largely unchanged, still near cycle-tight levels.

themes.headline: Mid-market PE fundraising pace slows for third straight quarter
themes.summary: New data shows LP commitments to mid-market buyout funds down again as distributions remain sluggish; sponsors increasingly leaning on continuation vehicles to return cash. Private credit fundraising, by contrast, continues to outpace PE.

watch_today: Two large continuation fund closings expected to price this week

themes.headline: Dollar firms broadly on CPI-driven rate repricing
themes.summary: DXY gained as markets pushed out cut expectations slightly; yen underperformed on the widening rate differential. Oil little changed ahead of tonight's inventory data.
